item.media:credit: Uli Deck/dpa (Photo by ULI DECK / dpa Picture-Alliance via AFP)
item.media:description: 07 October 2026, Baden-Württemberg, Karlsruhe: Unmarked police vehicles with flashing blue lights are driving onto the grounds of the Federal Court of Justice. Hanning, the former president of the Federal Intelligence Service, is to be brought before the investigating judge at the Federal Court of Justice in Karlsruhe. It is unknown whether Hanning is in one of the cars. The 80-year-old was arrested on Tuesday at his residence in North Rhine-Westphalia. The Federal Prosecutors Office accuses Hanning of acting as a secret service agent, espionage constituting treason, gathering state secrets, and attempted treason. Photo: Uli Deck/dpa (Photo by ULI DECK / dpa Picture-Alliance via AFP)

item.title: Video. Uragan Isaias poharao jug SAD-a: četvero mrtvih, na Floridi 420.000 ljudi bez struje
item.dc:creator: Katarina Škaro, Hina
item.description: Očekuje se da će tropska oluja Rachel kasnije pogoditi južnu Kaliforniju
item.media:description: A downed tree and damaged storefront signage is seen in Gulf Breeze, Florida, on October 10, 2026. The southeastern United States faced a high risk of flooding on Saturday as Isaias, weakened from a hurricane to a post-tropical cyclone, advanced northward from its landfall on Florida's Gulf Coast. Isaias roared ashore late Friday as a Category 2 hurricane near the resort community of Destin, Florida, packing sustained winds of 105 miles (165 kilometers) per hour, before weakening overnight, the National Hurricane Center (NHC) said. (Photo by RONALDO SCHEMIDT / AFP)
